device_entry.name: ADN4604/ADN4605 高速数字交叉点开关
tags: 高速数字链路路由与调试
device_entry.description: ADN4604/ADN4605 是一类高速数字交叉点交换芯片，用于将多个输入通道灵活映射到多个输出通道，并可配置收发通道相关参数，如均衡、驱动、信号选项和端接。实验室中常用于高速数字链路的路由、切换、通道分配与链路调试。
device_entry.description_en: The ADN4604/ADN4605 is a family of high-speed digital crosspoint switch ICs used to flexibly route multiple input channels to multiple output channels. It supports configuration of transmitter and receiver related settings such as equalization, drive, signal options, and termination. In laboratories, it is commonly used for high-speed digital link routing, switching, channel assignment, and link debugging.
